title: Rooms
intro: Rooms are where the work happens. You see the rooms you are a member of; administrators can see every room.
notFound: This room does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

rail.empty: You are not in any room yet

create.templateHint: The room copies its statuses and fields from it; later changes to the template do not touch the room.
create.templatesFailed: Could not load the workflow templates
create.noTemplates: There are no workflow templates yet. Ask an administrator to create one.
create.nameTaken: A room with this name already exists
create.templateGone: That template no longer exists. Pick another one.
create.invalid: The room could not be created: one or more fields are invalid
create.tooManyRequests: You are creating rooms too quickly. Wait a minute and try again.

validation.nameControl: Name must not contain control characters
validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 500 characters

settings.archivedNote: This room is archived, so its details are read-only. Unarchive it to edit them.
settings.readOnlyNote: Only the room's owners and administrators can change these settings.
settings.saveForbidden: Only the room's owners and administrators can change its details
settings.saveConflict: A room with this name already exists
settings.saveArchived: This room was archived in the meantime, so it can no longer be edited.
settings.saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
settings.saveGone: This room no longer exists, or you no longer have access to it — reload the page
settings.archiveHint: An archived room is read-only. Its members and history stay, and you can unarchive it at any time.
settings.archiveBody: “{{name}}” becomes read-only until someone unarchives it.
settings.unarchiveHint: This room is archived. Unarchive it to edit it again.
settings.deleteHint: Deleting a room removes it for everyone and frees its name. There is no undo.

moved.title: This room changed while you were editing
moved.message: Saving keeps your version. Reload to start again from the current one.

workflow.hint: This is the room's own copy of its workflow: the statuses and the extra fields every thread carries. Saving changes it for everyone in the room.
workflow.archivedNote: This room is archived, so its workflow is read-only. Unarchive it to edit it.
workflow.readOnlyNote: Only the room's owners and administrators can change the workflow.
workflow.invalid: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
workflow.saveForbidden: Only the room's owners and administrators can change the workflow
workflow.saveGone: This room no longer exists, or you no longer have access to it — reload the page
workflow.saveInvalid: The server rejected this workflow. Review its contents and try again.
workflow.saveArchived: This room was archived in the meantime, so its workflow can no longer be edited.
workflow.saveStatusInUse: Threads still use a status you removed or re-categorised. Choose where they move, or undo the change.
workflow.saveFieldType: A field with the key {{keys}} already existed with another type, and a field's type cannot change. Use the original type or pick another key.
workflow.saveKeyBudget: This room has used up the keys it may reserve (200 statuses and 200 fields, removed ones included). Re-use the key of a removed item instead of adding new ones.
workflow.staleTitle: Saved, but the latest version could not be loaded
workflow.stale: Your changes were saved. Reload the latest version before editing again, so nothing is saved twice.
workflow.saveStatusRecategorised: Threads now use {{statuses}}. The category of a status that threads use cannot change: set it back and save again.

members.title: Members
members.addTeamHint: Everyone on the team today becomes a member. Later changes to the team do not follow.
members.teamBody_one: “{{team}}” has {{count}} person. Add them to this room as a member? Anyone who is already in the room is skipped.
members.teamBody_other: “{{team}}” has {{count}} people. Add them all to this room as members? Anyone who is already in the room is skipped.
members.teamEmpty: This team has no members, so there is nobody to add.
members.addFailed: Could not add to the room
members.addForbidden: Only the room's owners and administrators can add members.
members.addInvalid: That person or team no longer exists.
members.addGone: This room no longer exists, or you no longer have access to it — reload the page
members.addFull: A room holds at most 500 members, so this would not fit. Nobody was added.
members.forbidden: Only the room's owners and administrators can do that.
members.gone: This person is no longer a member of the room.
members.lastOwner: A room needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
members.lastOwnerLeave: You are the only owner of this room. Make someone else an owner before you leave.
members.removeBody: {{name}} loses access to “{{room}}”. You can add them again later.
members.leaveBody: You lose access to “{{room}}” until an owner adds you again.

toast.teamAdded: Team added: {{added}} new, {{already}} already in the room
